cards.card_text: Who does he see standing at the right hand of God?
cards.verse_text: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

cards.card_text: And Stephen says it right out loud: "I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God." Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10).
cards.verse_text: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”

cards.card_text: Next Paul asks, "Who is there to condemn us?" He points to Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, and is at the right hand of God.
cards.verse_text: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.

cards.card_text: And baptism saves through the resurrection of Jesus Christ, who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God.
cards.verse_text: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ, who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.

cards.card_text: Jesus is at the right hand of God.
